title: 10/10 things quietly ruining your sleep
format: Notes listicle, app on one point
why: Variant of 01 (amayareading shape, 182K / 58K saves): same notes listicle and slide-4 confession, moved to the night side with fresh points and photos.
caption: number 2 hurt. which number got you? #sleep #screentime #sleeptips
check: slide 4: 'lasted a week'. Only if true for you

slides.heading: falling asleep _to a video_
slides.text:
your brain keeps half-listening

the background noise is still _input_

slides.heading: coffee _after 2pm_
slides.top: the buzz is gone by bedtime, the caffeine _isn't_
slides.text:
it hangs around for hours after you stop feeling it

move the last cup _earlier_

slides.heading: the _one last check_
slides.top: you put the phone down, then pick it up _one more time_
slides.text:
i tried willpower. _lasted a week_

now my apps _go to sleep at 11_ and there's nothing left to check

slides.heading: a _warm_ bedroom
slides.top: duvet, heating, laptop on the bed
slides.text:
cooler rooms make falling asleep easier

open the window for _ten minutes_ before bed

slides.heading: lying there _trying_ to sleep
slides.text:
if you're wide awake, get up and do something _boring_ in dim light

then try again
